_comment: Stage 4C - Chapter 5 (Fire). Governing default settled with this chapter: verified and worthwhile = keep; misattributed = repair or remove; unverified but genuinely relational = honestly frame and consider keeping; unverified and decorative = remove. An epigraph interrupts the author's voice and asks the reader to receive another voice with special weight; if the source cannot be established AND it adds no indispensable relationship, idea, challenge or illumination, the interruption has not earned itself.

entries.editorial_status: KEEP THE IDEA - RESTORE THE REAL IMAGE. The modern 'a fire to be kindled' wording was doing too much editorial work: wood -> fire conveniently made Plutarch fit the Fire chapter. Host-aligned alteration. The genuine image - the mind is not a vessel to fill but wood that needs igniting - works in Fire without falsifying him, and is now what the epigraph carries.
entries.translator_or_mediator: UNIDENTIFIED - the restored English follows the sense of the standard renderings (Waterfield, Penguin 1992: 'not a vessel that needs filling, but wood that needs igniting'); which translation to name is a Stage 7 decision.
entries.evidence_location: QUOTATION_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md (Plutarch, On Listening to Lectures); 4C Chapter 5 ruling

entries.match: May the light of your soul guide you
entries.editorial_status: KEEP. The closing blessing earns the interruption: it is not certification, it changes the register of the chapter and functions as an actual benediction. Permission risk does not decide editorial value - rights remain HIGH for Stage 6.

entries.match: The fire is the main comfort of the camp
entries.editorial_status: KEEP. Verified variant, accurate though truncated. Bibliography names the wrong book - Stage 7.

entries.match: The universe is a communion of subjects
entries.editorial_status: KEEP. Berry's signature formulation, attribution sound. Confirm at Stage 7 that The Great Work is a text where the sentence appears.

entries.editorial_status: KEEP. Genuine; an intervening sentence is dropped but what remains is accurate.
